gla_split.label: Sewerage
gla_split.method_note: Scottish Water, unmetered household charges 2026/27, page 5, Band D; 2025/26 from that year's leaflet. Other bands are Band D times Scottish Water's own ratios (Band H is twice Band D).

funding.label: Council tax
funding.official_term: Council Tax (net of Council Tax Reduction)
funding.desc: What residents pay through the council's part of the bill, after Council Tax Reduction
funding.method_note: POBE 2026 revenue workbook, sheet 'Glasgow City', 2026-27 budget estimate, rows 42.

funding.label: General Revenue Grant
funding.desc: The council's main general grant from the Scottish Government
funding.method_note: POBE 2026 revenue workbook, sheet 'Glasgow City', 2026-27 budget estimate, rows 38.

funding.label: Business rates (Scotland's shared pot)
funding.desc: Business rates are pooled across Scotland and shared out by the Scottish Government, so this is not what local businesses pay
funding.method_note: POBE 2026 revenue workbook, sheet 'Glasgow City', 2026-27 budget estimate, rows 41.

funding.label: Capital money used for day-to-day costs
funding.official_term: Use of capital resources to fund revenue costs as permitted by statute
funding.desc: One-off: money for building work used for day-to-day costs this year
funding.method_note: POBE 2026 revenue workbook, sheet 'Glasgow City', 2026-27 budget estimate, rows 62.

funding.label: Drawn from the capital fund
funding.desc: One-off: money set aside for building work used for day-to-day costs this year

funding.label: Drawn from council reserves
funding.official_term: General Fund balance and other reserves
funding.desc: One-off: once spent, the gap returns the year after
funding.method_note: POBE 2026 revenue workbook, sheet 'Glasgow City', 2026-27 budget estimate, rows 60 and 67 (General Fund balance at the start less at the end), 66.
